about_the_game:
The traffic control system in Green Wave has broken down!  Every light is stuck on red. That’s where you come in. Take control of the lights and switch them to green at just the right moment to keep the cars moving. But be careful: the lights will turn red again on their own, and drivers obey them without question. Time your actions perfectly to avoid pileups and restore order to the chaos!

Play through 15 handcrafted levels and bring every intersection back under control. Earn up to three stars per level for exceptional performance and smooth traffic flow.

About the development

Green Wave is my first completed solo project and a major step in my journey as an indie developer. I created it entirely in my free time alongside a full-time job, so while the scope is small and there may be a few rough edges, every part of it is built with care and enthusiasm.

There are currently no plans for new content, but I’m already working on my next project, applying everything I’ve learned from Green Wave.

If you’d like to follow my progress or learn more about the development process, check out my social media channels.
